description: Cursor-based order event feed (POST /b2b/v1/orders/events/query): new orders, state changes and issued receipts. Returns {cursor, orders_events: [{order_id, occurred, data: {type, …}}]} where data.type is state_change (with current_state), new_order, or receipt_issued (with receipt_id). Omit cursor for the first call, then keep passing the returned cursor — the feed is continuous, so poll again later with the last cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous response of this tool. Omit it for the first page; the feed is exhausted when a page comes back with fewer items than `limit`.

name: query_order_events
title: Poll the order event feed
